title: Monitoring Desk Standing Order — Back-Filling the Readings an Unmonitored Site Did Not Send
content:
# Monitoring Desk Standing Order — Back-Filling the Readings an Unmonitored Site Did Not Send

1. Where an energy monitoring subscription the owner holds stands active and reads its data from the controls system, a tenth of an hour — 0.1 of an hour — of controls technician time is charged for each meter that subscription covers, to back-fill the readings the site did not send while the plan under the Building Automation Service Plans stood unmonitored.
2. Where an energy monitoring subscription the owner holds stands active and reads its data from both the controls system and its own meters, half that back-fill charge is taken.
3. In every other case no back-fill charge at all is raised.
4. The time is charged at the tier's on-site controls technician rate, the charge taken to two decimal places.

The subscription, its standing, the source its data is drawn from and the meters it covers are read from the office's records of Energy Monitoring & Performance Subscriptions held by that owner.

| Energy monitoring subscription standing active | The source its data is drawn from | Back-fill charge |
|---|---|---|
| yes | the controls system | 0.1 of an hour of controls technician time for each meter it covers |
| yes | both the controls system and its own meters | half that charge |
| yes | its own meters only | none |
| no | not read | none |

**Worked figure (hypothetical).** An owner holding a subscription under the Energy Monitoring & Performance Subscriptions standing active, covering 20 meters and drawing its data from the controls system, at a plan tier whose on-site controls technician rate is 150 USD an hour: 20 meters at a tenth of an hour each is 2 hours, that is 300.00 USD. Drawing its data from both the controls system and its own meters, the charge would be 150.00 USD.
